name: nGZGraphic4::cDisplayMonitorW32::Create (cdecl factory: a 0x48-byte monitor object, count 0, no monitor, aspect 0, an empty name; the class 0x7b64ce01's entry in the graphics factory table)
notes: Lane VU (O-c, rendering R2b's leftover). Hooked at the RVA; ours is a real class with its compiler vtable in the image's slot order (vtable 0xd9c978: QueryInterface, AddRef, Release, the device name, the work area, the monitor rectangle, the aspect, SetMonitor, the monitor, the deleting destructor), so the image's vtable is carried by no object any more and its own slot bodies are in effect through this factory. Difftest DisplayMonitor_Lifetime (4000 seeded cases: the original made by 0x1545c0 and driven through its vtable, ours by Create; a seeded QueryInterface (ids 1, 0xfa12b663, 0xfb64c519 and others, a null out-pointer), AddRef, 1-2 SetMonitor calls with null, USER32-answered and fallback handles (the multimon statics preset: the stubs' init flag, the GetMonitorInfo pointer 0x10c96c8 a fake or null), every slot read, up to 2 more AddRefs, released to destruction; imports faked by impfx: SystemParametersInfoA, GetSystemMetrics, lstrcpyA, CreateDCA, GetDeviceCaps, DeleteDC; compared: the object's words, the name, the rectangles where defined, the slot answers, the import log). Mutants (build/vu_mut3b.json, 20 for the class): QI other id refused, QI no addref, release answers 1 (survived at first: counts never went above 2; the test now adds up to 2 references, then killed), unknown name short, default rect 801, aspect not reset, null monitor goes on, fallback any handle, metrics swapped, fallback work from monitor, no fallback device, work from monitor, dc driver null, vert asked as horz, aspect inverted, zero width divides, aspect unsigned, dc not deleted, factory aspect 1, factory counted: all killed.

name: nGZGraphic4::cDisplayMonitorW32::SetMonitor(HMONITOR) (the name UNKNOWN, aspect 0 and 800x600 first; for a monitor: GetMonitorInfo through the multimon stub, the device name and both rectangles, then the aspect from the device's HORZSIZE/VERTSIZE)
notes: Lane VU (O-c). Slot 7 of the image's vtable 0xd9c978, referenced only by it. The multimon GetMonitorInfo stub is inlined: USER32's through the pointer 0x10c96c8 when nMultiMon::InitMultipleMonitorStubs (ours) found it, else the one-monitor fallback for the stand-in handle 0x12340042 (screen metrics, SPI_GETWORKAREA, primary, lstrcpyA DISPLAY). CreateDCA(device, device, 0, 0), the aspect float(width)/float(height) only when both sizes are non-zero, DeleteDC. ORIGINAL-BUG: the info structure is left uninitialised but for its size, so when the stub writes nothing the original takes stack bytes as the name and rectangles; ours starts it zeroed (the test skips those cases' name and rectangles). In effect through callers: as 0x1547b0. Difftest and mutants: as 0x1545c0's (14 of the 20 aimed here, all killed).

name: nGZGraphic4::cDisplayMonitorW32::DeletingDestructor(flags) (frees the name; operator delete when flags bit 0)
notes: Lane VU (O-c). Slot 9 of the image's vtable 0xd9c978 (and the factory's only other reference to it), referenced only by that vtable. Ours is the compiler's deleting destructor (the defaulted virtual destructor; std::string frees the name), reached from Release. In effect through callers: as 0x1547b0. Difftest: as 0x1545c0's (every case released to destruction; the allocator is the harness's, so a leak or double free fails the case); mutants: release answers 1 (the count reaches 0 at the right release), factory counted: killed.
